title: Penthouse Magazine November 2001 Mario Puzo Vintage
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, November 2001 issue. Features "The Family" — Mario Puzo's final novel (excerpt), plus "Wake Up, America!" special report, "Stripping Goes Global," and Minnesota Vikings' Mitch Berger.
Complete issue, no missing pages noted. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
